sources.role: subject order text (OCR of archival replica)

sources.quote: It is hereby ordered that Executive Order No. 3918, dated October 29, 1923, withdrawing the public lands in secs. 4, 5, and 6, T. 17 S., R. 10 E., San Bernardino meridian, pending a resurvey, be, and the same is hereby, revoked.

sources.role: revoking order, second copy (date and signer)

rationale: Single operative clause: withdrawal pending resurvey, ending on approval of resurvey plat unless another date fixed by the GLO Commissioner. EO 5446 (Hoover, September 18, 1930) expressly revokes EO 3918 by number and date; no clause survives. Identity matches the held ProQuest-OCR text (Coolidge, October 29, 1923, secs. 4,5,6 T.17S R.10E SBM, No. 3918). Research-only proposal; text is a working text, original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
material_gaps: Held text of EO 3918 is an OCR of an archival replica scan; page check pending. Quote of the order itself is OCR-garbled, but the EO 5446 quote is clean.
